quote: Build me a small app that keeps track of everything in my home, with a paid pro version that uses Stripe.

say: Talk hears it and fills in the idea.
I pick the cheapest team: an Opus planner and six Haiku agents, with its estimate.

cap: The brief: the team, no reviewer, and what happens next.

say: The planner splits the app into parts; an agent takes each one, on its own copy.

quote: Please add a dark mode to the app.

say: Mid-build, one more request. It joins the plan.
It lands while the others work. Collisions are redone on the newest code, not sent back. One agent's machine never started; the page said so.
All ten parts landed in about twenty-five minutes, for two dollars of model time.
The dark mode's record: what it was asked, no reviewer in this setup, checks passed, landed.
